decisions.reason: The hierarchical search plugin has no traction or visibility, so its option value is unlikely to be realized and it should be abandoned.
The mobile map layer control addresses a strategic need in mobile usability and costs little to keep the option open.
As the flagship platform and focus of the firm's direction, its strategic option value remains high and it is unlikely to be dropped.
The search extension overlaps with other offerings and has had no visible traction, making the option unlikely to pay off.
